latest_release.body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 4.9.0 -->

## What's Changed

### ✨ New Features
* Add option to open workspace sidebar items in new tab by @sebastianruff in https://github.com/lissy93/dashy/pull/2363
* Shiny new workspace view by @lissy93 in https://github.com/lissy93/dashy/pull/2404

### 🦋 Bug Fixes
* Fix config files being readable without login via encoded URLs by @lissy93 in https://github.com/lissy93/dashy/pull/2387
* Fix Firefix col counting, and rss in sample config by @lissy93 in https://github.com/lissy93/dashy/pull/2405

### 🎨 Themes and Styling
* feat(theme): add liquid-glass built-in theme by @KeuqS in https://github.com/lissy93/dashy/pull/2385

### 🌐 Localization
* Complete Arabic translation and fix broken Hindi placeholders by @Mohamed-Almarag in https://github.com/lissy93/dashy/pull/2394
* Complete and polish Chinese (zh-CN) translations by @zcq100 in https://github.com/lissy93/dashy/pull/2399

### 📕 Documentation
* Add warning guest access http auth by @lissy93 in https://github.com/lissy93/dashy/pull/2389
* Updates troubleshooting guide by @lissy93 in https://github.com/lissy93/dashy/pull/2392
* Adds translation credits to the readme by @lissy93 in https://github.com/lissy93/dashy/pull/2395
* Update sponsors in readme by @lissy93 in https://github.com/lissy93/dashy/pull/2406

### 📦 Dependencies
* Bump vitest from 5.0.3 to 5.0.4 in the vitest group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/lissy93/dashy/pull/2396
* Bump happy-dom from 20.14.5 to 21.0.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/lissy93/dashy/pull/2398
* Bump the minor-and-patch group across 1 directory with 15 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/lissy93/dashy/pull/2397
* Bump vitest from 5.0.4 to 5.0.5 in the vitest group by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/lissy93/dashy/pull/2402
* Bump the minor-and-patch group with 11 updates by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/lissy93/dashy/pull/2403

## New Contributors
* @Mohamed-Almarag made their first contribution in https://github.com/lissy93/dashy/pull/2394
* @sebastianruff made their first contribution in https://github.com/lissy93/dashy/pull/2363

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/lissy93/dashy/compare/4.8.0...4.9.0
